positive.sql:
SELECT id, name, rate_to_usd AS last_rate_to_usd
FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY updated DESC) AS rn FROM currency) t
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY id;

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.rate_to_usd AS last_rate_to_usd
FROM currency c
WHERE c.updated = (SELECT MAX(updated) FROM currency WHERE id = c.id)
ORDER BY c.id;
